reviews.text: This was my first time bringing my dog here, I came specifically for the fur dye and IT CAME OUT BEAUTIFULLY. Staff was super nice, establishment super cute, customer service was great I’m very happy with my visit. They even gave my dog a photo op which was unexpected. Updated me through text and videos during her cut process which I really appreciated. 10/10Would recommend

After taking my dog in for full service full bath with grooming , teeth cleaning , and nail cutting they called me to tell me that my dog (Yorkie) has some matting and they will need to charge for that an extra 10/15 dollars . If you know about yorkies you would know that they do not have any matting and I'm always on top of my dogs hair . Nevertheless, I paid $150. Within hours that same day I noticed a bug crawling around my dogs skin . I took him back the next day to say that I noticed a bug or something and that my dog was scratching . They told me I would need to pay for a flea and tick bath . I proceeded to tell them that I should pay for this because it wasn't my fault neither did my dog have this when he got a full haircut and no one noticed meaning my dog didn't have this prior to being in there getting a haircut . The lady front desk told me I t would be $30 I said I'm sorry I won't be doing it and I shouldn't have to pay for it . Instead I told her give him a bath and not the flea and tick . I said as complementary . She said they can't do it but then I asked to call the manager . She calls gets on the phone and takes the dog . I'm thinking everything is okay . They are done with the dog wash . Comes out and tell me it is $70 . I said I thought you were doing the bath as complimentary . She said we don't do that and I told you . I said I thought you had told me if I wanted to do the flea and tick will be $30 my responsibility which is why I said no and just take fhim a bath given that he had received one yesterday with the haircut and everything . She was rude nasty telling me I wanted free service . Didn't want to let me leave the shop until I called the cops
terrible customer service

⚠️ BEWARE. DO NOT BRING YOUR PET HERE.

This grooming salon has left pet owners feeling shocked, disrespected, and deeply disturbed. Customers have reported being spoken to with hostility while paying premium prices for services that failed to meet expectations. What should have been a routine grooming appointment became an experience that left them sick to their stomach.

No pet owner should ever leave a groomer questioning how their beloved animal was treated. If your pet is family, think twice before trusting this business with their care.
Rough with dogs and very aggressive with females specifically!

I was very disappointed with my experience at this pet grooming salon. The customer service was unprofessional, and I felt like my concerns were brushed off instead of being taken seriously. My pet did not receive the level of care I expected, and the grooming quality was below standard. The staff came across as rude and unwelcoming, which made the entire experience uncomfortable. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning and cannot recommend this business based on my experience.

Worst place ever don’t come here. staff was rude, dismissive, and completely unprofessional. On top of the disrespectful customer service I was deeply disturbed by what I personally witnessed and left with serious concerns about how animals are treated here. My experience made me feel that my pet’s well being was not a priority. There are far too many caring, professional groomers out there to risk bringing your pet here. I cannot recommend this business and will never be returning!!!

Do yourself a favor and go to another groomer. This place is known for abusing dog when getting groomed. They treat their valued customers with disrespect and after Paying premium prices I was left feeling sick to my stomach with the level of stupidity I dealt with. I was spoken to with extreme hostility and I pray that no one comes to this place if you truly love your pet. I promise you that my words are full of genuine concern.
DON'T COME TO THIS PLACEEEEE!!!!!

We are blessed to have them in our neighborhood - they like to take care of our pets, and i like how they send me the status reports with fotos and videos.
My Husky is a tough customer. They made her ( and frankly - me) at ease. And she looks gorgeous after the visit. Thank you - you will see me and Luci again!
Great work great team thanks !
They are wonderful grooming place. No complaints. Thanks for the photos and videos shared of my dog during the entire grooming session.
They are wonderful pet groomers. Very efficient and knowledgeable. I love the photoshoot they provide with your pet so you can keep the memories.

Thank you so much for the wonderful service and the amazing haircut you gave my dog. You were gentle, patient, and clearly skilled, and it really shows in how great he looks. I appreciate the care and attention you put into your work we’ll definitely be coming back and we always do 🐾

Thank you for always taking such great care of my little boy, Pixel. I appreciate the updates with pictures throughout the bath and grooming process, as well as the final “postal” picture and the free bow or bandana. Their communication is excellent, confirming appointments, sending reminders, and making sure all my expectations are met.

Pixel is a dog who doesn’t like to be touched, but his groomer, Lucky, is very friendly and patient, which has really helped him feel more confident.

Thank you for everything!
Amazing job ! Thanks to the girl in the front desk very sweet nice staff !
Amazing place and staff! Chanel loves it !!
Everyone was sweet and took great crate of him :) he was happy after they finished and he looks so handsome. Glad I came here

I came in a couple of weeks ago to have my cat deshed. She's not able to groom herself as well  due to her CH. Despite regular brushing she didn't seem to shed her winter coat. She is not shedding nearly as much after her grooming session - barely any fur comes off on the brush I use. They did a wonderful job and they were able to get her bathed and deshed in under an hour!

This place is absolutely great. They keep you updated with anything you take your pet to get done with photos and text messages. My cat isn’t the best behaved and they really put a lot of care into his “spa day”. He’s going back every month 12/10 recommend. P.s he smelled and looked amazing after. Great service !!!

Petness Wanderer always does an amazing job on Franco. I appreciate how accommodating they are with my last minute appointments and they know exactly how to style him. They update you with text messages and pictures which puts me at ease as a dog owner of a partially blind senior dog. Plus they give this cute photoshoot at the end! We’ve been here numerous times, I highly recommend bringing your pets here for grooming.
My girls always look and smell so amazing after I take them to their groomer, they always take care of them very well. I recommend this place to all my friends 💕 …

When I got there I saw a lot of dogs got a little anxious 😅😂 but they are very professional as far as I was there also they did work fast and got the job done my dog was calm and he smelled great also I did like that’s they kept me updated on his progress. …
THEY ALWAYS SAVE ME ♥️✨THEY PUT THEM SO BEAUTIFUL

Brought my second Dog for a wash and added spots to her which came out great on my dog plain Jane .. i was told it was a little hassle since she’s never been to a groomer but over all I’m happy with the results for both my dogs I brought into the establishment

Toby came out looking and smelling amazing—better than I ever could have imagined. The cut was perfect, and they even took the time to ask about specific preferences. Their attention to detail and gentle approach made all the difference.

The facility was clean, welcoming, and organized, and the staff made us feel right at home. I highly recommend PetnessWanderer to anyone looking for a reliable and talented groomer. We’ll definitely be back! 😄😃
They were really careful with my dog, and the handoff was really simple. Would definitely recommend.

I called and spoke with a female twice at length make an appointment gave my name as well as my dogs when I arrived the man working had no knowledge of my appointment I was also given a quote for a nail grinding for my dog the choke collar that the man put around my dog's neck was unnecessary he then went about grinding my dog's nails but traumatizing her completely in the process he then overcharged me and tell me the next time I came it would be even more it literally took him less than 3 minutes I literally said I would never be back if your pet is like family I do not recommend that you bring them here
The best coustomer service and my dog Maurice loves them ..Honest personal left credit card they ensure It was delivered safe to myself in less than a hour love love them
Super friendly staff they take very good care of your dog. I always know my old boy is in good hands. They do the grooming exactly how you want it.Best grooming services my dog ever received!
Wonderful experience like always, friendly staff, they take great care of your pets. My dog always comes out so glamorous from there 🥰 …
Treat my dog really well
I was quoted $90 on the phone for a full cat grooming and was told $180 when I got there. That price is outrageous and I wasted my time commuting there.
It was a great first time experience for our 2 pups. Our groomer Barbara took great care of them and provided progress photos throughout. Thank you Barbara and PetsWell! ❤️🐶 …
They did a fantastic job with my 12-year-old dog who struggles with haircuts. After washing, they took pictures to showcase the haircut, making the experience feel incredible.

Petness world was a wonderful experience! I took my cat to get groomed here and they did a full service of hair and nail trimming, full wash, and even gave us a sweet little collar. They made me feel very comfortable with leaving my cat amongst all the other dogs and kept me updated through texts and pictures. Highly recommend!

Wonderful people!!
They did a great work with my Tobby
